expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The message states: "in 2024 retries that drew a fresh key for each attempt charged 41 members twice," explains that every attempt uses the first attempt's key because the gateway can time out after charging, and asks for confirmation before changing to fresh keys.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page

expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step 4; first edit at step None
